metadata.name: drawsol
metadata.description: DrawSol v4 - escrowed end prize, published instant-prize schedule, random ticket numbers via ORAO VRF

instructions.name: buy_tickets
docs: Buys `quantity` (≤ max_per_tx ≤ 1000) tickets as one entry and requests its ORAO randomness.

accounts.name: entry
docs: Sized from `quantity` (tickets + prizes vectors). Clamped to MAX_PER_TX so an oversized quantity
fails with `ExceedsPerTx` in the handler rather than with the allocator's size limit.

accounts.name: buyer
docs: Pays the tickets, the ORAO fee and rent; becomes the entry owner.

accounts.name: vrf_request
docs: and created by the ORAO CPI (`init`, so never reused).

instructions.name: cancel_draw
docs: Cancels a draw whose randomness never arrived (anyone, 48 h after draw_at) or a Draft (authority).

instructions.name: claim_free_entry
docs: One free ticket per wallet, up to `free_cap`: a normal ticket in every respect.

instructions.name: claim_refund
docs: Permissionless. Refunds an entry of a cancelled draw (paid − instant prizes received).

instructions.name: create_draw
docs: Admin or keeper. Creates a Draft draw with its vault, pool header and (zeroed) schedule.
Validates the SPEC-v4 §1 inequalities.

accounts.name: pool
docs: Header only (`remaining = 0`); `init_pool` grows and fills it.

accounts.name: schedule
docs: Zeroed; full size when `8 + cap ≤ 10 KB`, else grown by `init_pool`.

accounts.name: creator
docs: Admin or keeper; pays rent only (the escrow comes from the authority at `open_draw`).

instructions.name: init_config
docs: Fresh deployments: creates the Config. Signer must be the program's upgrade authority.

instructions.name: init_pool
docs: Admin or keeper. Fills `pool[from..to] = from..to` (sequential chunks of ≤ 2000), growing the account.

instructions.name: legacy_close_v3
docs: Admin only. Closes a v3 draw + vault (raw-byte parse) into the admin: zero entries (escrow back),
or Settled / Cancelled with nothing owed.

accounts.name: admin
docs: Receives every lamport of the v3 draw and vault.

instructions.name: open_draw
docs: Authority. Draft → Open: pool complete, schedule complete, escrows end prize + schedule total,
emits the schedule hash.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Escrows the prizes.

instructions.name: request_draw
docs: At draw_at: keeper/authority first, anyone after the public grace. Requests the end-prize
randomness, or cancels and returns the escrow when nothing was sold.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the ORAO fee; must be the keeper or the authority during the grace window.

accounts.name: vrf_request
docs: Not needed when the draw is cancelled here (no tickets).

instructions.name: reveal_entry
docs: Permissionless. Assigns the entry's ticket numbers at random from the pool, looks them up in the
schedule and pays the instant prizes from the vault to the owner.

instructions.name: self_exclude
docs: Self-exclusion until `until` (unix seconds); can only be extended.

instructions.name: set_keeper
docs: Admin only.

instructions.name: set_limit
docs: Spend limit per 30 days (0 = none). Decrease now, increase after 72 h.

instructions.name: set_schedule
docs: Admin or keeper. Registers winning numbers (≤ 300 per call), each once, per-tier counts enforced.

instructions.name: settle_draw
docs: Permissionless. Pays the end prize (or the fallback pot) to the owner of the entry holding the
winning position; returns unused escrow to the authority.

instructions.name: withdraw
docs: Authority only. House share (+ released schedule escrow) after settlement; a cancelled draw's escrow.

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: Signer is not allowed to perform this action

errors.name: InvalidParams
errors.msg: Invalid parameters

errors.name: SalesClosed
errors.msg: Sales for this draw are closed

errors.name: SalesStillOpen
errors.msg: Sales are still open: the draw is not due yet

errors.name: SoldOut
errors.msg: Not enough tickets left

errors.name: ExceedsPerTx
errors.msg: Quantity exceeds the per-transaction limit

errors.name: ExceedsWalletCap
errors.msg: Quantity exceeds the per-wallet limit

errors.name: FreeCapReached
errors.msg: All free entries have been claimed

errors.name: FreeAlreadyClaimed
errors.msg: This wallet already claimed its free entry

errors.name: WrongStatus
errors.msg: The draw is not in the right status for this action

errors.name: VrfWrongOwner

errors.name: VrfWrongAccount

errors.name: VrfSeedMismatch
errors.msg: Randomness seed mismatch

errors.name: VrfNotFulfilled

errors.name: AlreadyRevealed
errors.msg: Entry already revealed

errors.name: WrongWinningEntry
errors.msg: This entry does not hold the winning position

errors.name: WinnerNotRevealed
errors.msg: The winning entry has not been revealed yet

errors.name: NotCancellable
errors.msg: The draw cannot be cancelled yet

errors.name: AlreadyRefunded
errors.msg: Entry already refunded

errors.name: NothingToRefund
errors.msg: Nothing to refund for this entry

errors.name: NothingToWithdraw
errors.msg: Nothing to withdraw right now

errors.name: MathOverflow
errors.msg: Arithmetic overflow

errors.name: DrawNotDue
errors.msg: The draw is not due yet (draw_at)

errors.name: SpendLimitExceeded
errors.msg: This purchase would exceed your spend limit for the period

errors.name: SelfExcluded
errors.msg: This wallet is self-excluded

errors.name: VaultShortfall
errors.msg: The vault cannot cover this payment yet; the operator must top it up

errors.name: NotLegacyAccount
errors.msg: Account is not a legacy account of this program

errors.name: LegacyNotClosable
errors.msg: The legacy draw still holds liabilities and cannot be closed

errors.name: WrongSideAccount
errors.msg: Pool / Schedule account is not the draw's (owner, seeds or discriminator)

errors.name: BadPoolChunk
errors.msg: init_pool chunk must start at the next unfilled number and hold 1..=2000 numbers up to the cap

errors.name: PoolIncomplete
errors.msg: The pool is not fully initialised yet

errors.name: BadScheduleBatch
errors.msg: Schedule batch is empty or larger than 300

errors.name: DuplicateScheduleTicket
errors.msg: This ticket number is already in the schedule

errors.name: TierFull
errors.msg: This tier already has every winning number registered

errors.name: ScheduleIncomplete
errors.msg: Not every tier has all its winning numbers registered

errors.name: PoolExhausted
errors.msg: The pool is corrupt: no numbers left to assign

types.name: Config
docs: seeds = [b"config"]
Unchanged since v3 (`admin, keeper, next_draw_id, bump`); devnet's account is already in this layout.

fields.name: keeper
docs: Low-trust automation key: may create draws, fill pools/schedules and request draws during the
public-grace window. It never escrows money and never receives the house share.

types.name: DrawCancelled
docs: reason: 0 = no tickets, 1 = randomness timeout, 3 = draft cancelled by the authority

fields.name: schedule_hash
docs: sha256 of the `ticket_cap` schedule bytes (tier index + 1 per number, 0 = no prize) at opening

fields.name: escrow_lamports
docs: end prize + schedule total, escrowed by the authority

fields.name: fallback
docs: true when `paid_tickets < min_tickets` and the fallback pot was paid instead of the end prize

types.name: DrawV4
docs: seeds = [b"draw4", id.to_le_bytes()]

fields.name: authority
docs: config.admin at creation; escrows the prizes at `open_draw`, receives the house share / returned escrow

fields.name: ticket_cap
docs: ticket numbers are 0..ticket_cap; every ticket (paid or free) takes one number, so this caps all tickets

fields.name: max_per_wallet
docs: all ticket kinds

fields.name: draw_at
docs: >= closes_at; sell-out ends sales early, the draw still waits for draw_at

fields.name: public_grace_secs
docs: only keeper/authority may request the draw during [draw_at, draw_at + grace)

fields.name: end_prize_lamports
docs: fixed end prize, escrowed at open; paid in full when paid_tickets >= min_tickets

fields.name: schedule_total_lamports
docs: Σ tiers.amount × count — escrowed at open

fields.name: schedule_set
docs: winning numbers registered so far (== Σ tiers.count once Open)

fields.name: instants_paid
docs: instant prizes paid so far

fields.name: revenue
docs: every lamport paid for tickets

fields.name: house_lamports
docs: fixed at settle: revenue − fallback pot (if paid); withdrawable after Settled

fields.name: assigned
docs: tickets that have a number (revealed)

fields.name: next_pos
docs: positions handed out: every ticket (paid or free) gets the next position at purchase

fields.name: end_prize_paid
docs: what the winner actually received (end prize, or the fallback pot)

fields.name: prize_paid
docs: the prize was disbursed (to the winner, or the fallback pot was paid)

fields.name: escrow_returned
docs: the end-prize escrow has left the vault (paid to the winner, or returned to the authority)

fields.name: instant_escrow_returned
docs: the unwon part of the schedule escrow (schedule_total − instants_paid) was returned to the authority

fields.name: prizes
docs: per ticket: 0 = no prize, t+1 = tier t

types.name: EntryV4
docs: seeds = [b"entry4", draw.key(), seq.to_le_bytes()] where seq = draw.entry_count at creation.
Space is sized from `count` at purchase: `EntryV4::space(count)`.
Fixed-size fields come first (memcmp-friendly offsets: draw @8, owner @40, seq @72, first_pos @76,
count @80, is_free @82, ...); the two vectors are at the end.

fields.name: first_pos
docs: positions first_pos .. first_pos + count belong to this entry (the end-prize draw picks a position)

fields.name: vrf_request
docs: ORAO randomness request PDA for this entry's ticket assignment

fields.name: instant_paid
docs: instant prizes paid to the owner at reveal

fields.name: tickets
docs: ticket numbers, len == count once revealed (empty before)

fields.name: prizes
docs: per ticket: 0 = no prize, t + 1 = tier t (len == count once revealed)

fields.name: pending_from
docs: 0 = nothing pending

fields.name: num_received
docs: Total number of received requests.

fields.name: mint
docs: ORAO token mint address.

fields.name: treasury
docs: ORAO token treasury account.

fields.name: fee
docs: Fee in ORAO SPL token smallest units.

types.name: PlayerV4
docs: seeds = [b"player4", draw.key(), wallet]

fields.name: tickets
docs: all kinds (paid + free)

fields.name: paid
docs: lamports paid for tickets

fields.name: won_lamports
docs: instant prizes received

types.name: Pool
docs: seeds = [b"pool", draw.key()]. Raw layout after the discriminator: `remaining: u32` then
`u32[ticket_cap]` ticket numbers. Filled 0..cap by `init_pool`; `reveal_entry` swap-removes from
`[..remaining]`. Accessed by raw bytes (never deserialised) — this type only names the discriminator.

types.name: Profile
docs: seeds = [b"profile", wallet]. Global across draws. Unchanged since v3 (SPEC-v3 §2.6).

fields.name: credits
docs: v3 free-ticket credits; kept for layout compatibility, unused in v4 (no credit tiers)

fields.name: limit_lamports
docs: 0 = no limit

fields.name: pending_from
docs: 0 = no pending change; otherwise `pending_limit` applies from this time

types.name: Schedule
docs: seeds = [b"schedule", draw.key()]. Raw layout after the discriminator: `u8[ticket_cap]`,
`0` = no prize, `1..=8` = tier index + 1, bit 7 = that number's prize has been won.

fields.name: ticket
docs: winning ticket number, < ticket_cap

fields.name: tier
docs: tier index 0..8 (stored in the schedule as tier + 1)

fields.name: schedule_set
docs: winning numbers registered so far

types.name: Tier
docs: One instant-prize tier. Unused = all zero.

fields.name: amount
docs: prize per winning number, lamports

fields.name: count
docs: winning numbers in the schedule

fields.name: set
docs: winning numbers registered so far by `set_schedule` (== count once the draw is Open)

fields.name: won
docs: winning numbers assigned (and paid) so far

fields.name: amount
docs: prize per winning number, lamports (0 = unused tier)

fields.name: count
docs: winning numbers of this tier

types.name: Vault
docs: seeds = [b"vault4", draw.key()]. Program-owned, no fields: its lamports are everything the draw holds.
Debited directly by the program; it always stays rent-exempt.
